conflict_rule: Offer a diagnostic only for a recorded time-source conflict or an explicitly requested check. Do not infer new conflicts or run offset analysis.
main_axis: Use paper sampling times only with source evidence; otherwise retain digitized basis with provenance qualification.
provenance: All nominal/pixel values, units, status and source cells remain in EC companion tables.
administration_routes: Separate known administration routes into independent figures. Doses within the same route may share a figure. Do not merge unspecified routes with known routes.
axis_detail: Range-aware Y ticks; finer early time X ticks where useful, preserving scale and source coordinates.
time_caption: Label the displayed time basis in plain English: nominal study-method sampling times, reported sampling schedule, or digitized figure times, as supported by the selected column and its evidence. A paper sampling schedule does not establish actual per-animal collection times. Do not print internal time-basis codes in captions or imply that a display choice finalizes the modeling time axis.
time_conflict_scope: Time conflicts are scoped to the current study, route and matrix. A blood/plasma sampling conflict does not trigger a tissue or ELF time-check figure; an SC-specific warning does not apply to IT. Recognize explicit matrix-specific source schedules when the existing source-time values match; never snap digitized points or invent times. Prefer that supported source time in the main figure; retain pixel time in immutable provenance, not a duplicate main plot. Generate an alternate-time diagnostic only for a conflict applicable to that series or an explicit request; small numeric differences alone are not a trigger. Remove unrelated warnings from figure captions but retain the original notes in source records.
